mechanism: Amiodarone may potentiate the effects of levodopa through CYP450 inhibition and direct pharmacodynamic effects on dopaminergic and adrenergic systems, potentially increasing cardiovascular and neuropsychiatric adverse effects.
action: Monitor for increased levodopa adverse effects (dyskinesias, arrhythmias, hypertension); consider dose adjustment of levodopa or alternative antiarrhythmic if adverse effects emerge.
